entries.name: 黑人哲学
entries.recognitionCue: Complete foreground path, tall baobab and its full branches on right, river valley, architectural landscape, spires, soft gold/cool-green light and far mountains. Preserve the environment-focused original without inventing stereotyped foreground people or extra symbols.

entries.name: 天演论
entries.recognitionCue: Late-Qing river city and trade/navigation scene, whole foreground scholarly pavilion with books/manuscripts and observation of the city, different traditional/modern boats, buildings, bridges, cranes and distant mountain haze. Keep historical transition and the specific instruments/texts, no giant evolution diagram, new portrait or political slogan.

entries.name: 分析哲学
entries.recognitionCue: Modern academic seminar room with distinct suited thinkers studying papers and diagrams, foreground writing desks, books and lamp, standing chalkboard discussion and sunlight through tall windows. Preserve analytic clarification and logical discussion through purposeful gestures and quiet existing chalk traces. Refine the very photographic people/fabric into fine oil-painted planes and glazes; maintain realistic modern architecture, no classical temple, floating giant equations or coarse impasto.
